subject: Orbit Analytics: vendor gate - security deliverables & PO path
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@orbitanalytics.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, procurement@orbitanalytics.com
Cc: Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@orbitanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor security artifacts + PO intake for Redwood (Orbit Analytics)

Hi Soojin —

Quick intro: I'm Lena (Ops, Orbit Analytics). We're ready to move Redwood into our vendor roster but procurement needs the following to complete the gate:

- Fully executed DPA (DocuSign or PDF)
- Latest SOC 2 report or a trust center link
- Current subprocessor inventory (with country and data access notes)
- PO instructions and invoicing contact (we normally do Net45 but can do Net30 if required)

Can you supply the DPA and a SOC2 link? Also please confirm whether Redwood accepts our PO reference flow (we need Redwood's AP invoice email and a billing address). If DocuSign is preferred, send the link and we'll route internally.

Target go-live: 2026-10-15. Any blockers we should surface now?

Thanks —
Lena Ortiz
Head of Ops, Orbit Analytics
procurement@orbitanalytics.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@orbitanalytics.com>, procurement@orbitanalytics.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 18:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor security artifacts + PO intake for Redwood (Orbit Analytics)

Hi Lena — great to meet you. Thanks for the clear checklist.

Attached you'll find: Orbit_DPA_Redwood_v3_20261005.pdf (ready for signature), and subprocessor_inventory_20261005.csv.
For SOC 2, we host the latest report at our trust center: https://trust.redwood.ai/soc2/2026-report (passcode: available on request via secure link). The public summary and attestations are in the link; if your team needs the encrypted full report we can provide a time-limited download.

PO / invoicing details:
- AP email: ap@redwood.ai
- Billing address: Redwood Inference, 125 Market St., San Francisco, CA 94105
- Default payment terms: Net30. We can approve Net45 for strategic deals but need a short internal exception (see below).

DocuSign: I can send the DPA via DocuSign now (I included a DocuSign link in related_links). If you prefer to countersign and upload, that's fine too.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm preferred DPA signing method (DocuSign or signed PDF).
2) Orbit issues PO referencing ORB-2026-0911 and sends to ap@redwood.ai.
3) Once DPA is fully executed and we confirm PO arrival, we flip the production toggle and set the customer workspace.

I'm cc'ing Laura (Finance) to confirm Net45 exception path. If there's an urgent compliance checkpoint, we can pre-authorize tokens for a pilot while forms complete.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Vendor Success Manager
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai

Can we approve Net45 for this account? It's a mid-market prospect with a target go-live of 2026-10-15. If we can sign off with a short exception (finance approval + 45-day term), I'll confirm to Orbit and request the PO.

Soojin — approved on exception basis. We can accept Net45 for ORB-2026-0911 with the following conditions:

- Finance to issue invoice upon receipt of PO and after DPA countersignature.
- PO must reference "ORB-2026-0911" and include contact details for Orbit AP.
- Require a signed DPA before provisioning production keys (pilot tokens may be issued earlier for testing).

I've asked Laura to prepare the internal approval note and I've attached the PO stub for your reference (PO_REDWOOD_2026_0911.pdf). Please confirm once Orbit sends the signed DPA and PO and we'll route invoicing.

On the SOC2: if Orbit needs the encrypted report, request a secure file transfer; I'll approve a time-limited share.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Head of Finance (Interim)
